# Ball Trajectory Analysis

## Initial Conditions
The ball starts near the **top center** of the frame, slightly left of center.

## Tracing the Path

**Step 1:** The ball falls under gravity and hits the **first line** (upper-left to mid-right, sloping slightly downward to the right). This deflects the ball to the **right**, and it slides/rolls toward the right end of the line.

**Step 2:** Falling off the right end of Line 1 (~x=540), the ball drops onto **Line 2** (which runs from mid-left upward to the upper-right). Since this line slopes **upward to the right**, the ball is deflected back to the **left**, sliding down toward the left end of this line.

**Step 3:** The ball falls off Line 2's left end (~x=240) and drops onto **Line 3** (running from the left side down toward center-right). This line slopes **downward to the right**, sending the ball sliding to the right again, exiting around x=500.

**Step 4:** From x≈500 at the lower portion of the frame, the ball falls straight down. This x-position aligns with the **center bucket** (Bucket 2).

## Conclusion
The alternating deflections (right → left → right) bring the ball to a center trajectory that feeds directly into the middle bucket.
